method:
Static call-graph traversal of the source extract of commit 3375aadb (read-only; nothing executed). I started at the [CommandMethod] entry points and followed every call into RackCad.Plugin, which is the only project that references AutoCAD. FACT: no `using Autodesk` exists outside src/RackCad.Plugin, and the RackCad.UI and RackCad.Application csproj files hold no AutoCAD references, so the WPF windows and the pure builders cannot mutate the Database. Chain abbreviations used below:
- E1 = RACKSELECTIVO/RS (RackSelectivoCommands.cs:23,26-39).
- E2 = RACKCAD/RK SelectiveInsertionRequest dispatch (RackMenuCommands.cs:17,21,76-79).
- Both reach DrawSelectiveView (RackSelectivoCommands.cs:429-432), then DrawSelectiveViewFromAuthored (:449-476).
- F = frontal branch: :475 -> InsertSelectiveFrontal (:484-523, fondo prompt :508, payload :519, name :520) -> SelectiveFrontalDrawService.DrawAndPlace (SelectiveFrontalDrawService.cs:31-39).
- P = planta branch: :467-472 -> SelectivePlantaDrawService.DrawAndPlace (SelectivePlantaDrawService.cs:26-34).
- F and P both enter ViewBlockDraw.DrawAndPlace (ViewBlockDraw.cs:28-57).
- W = the ViewBlockDraw.cs:50 call to SystemBlockWriter.CreateBlock (SystemBlockWriter.cs:18-40).
- I = SystemBlockWriter.cs:25 -> BlockLibraryImporter.EnsureForPlan (BlockLibraryImporter.cs:25-39) -> LibraryBlockAvailabilityFlow.Observe (LibraryBlockRequirements.cs:158-180) -> ImportAdapter.Ensure (BlockLibraryImporter.cs:140-141) -> EnsureBlocks (:50-132).
- D = SystemBlockWriter.cs:29 -> LateralHeaderDrawer.CreateSystemBlock (LateralHeaderDrawer.cs:28-81).
- PL = ViewBlockDraw.cs:51 -> BlockPlacement.PlaceAndReport (BlockPlacement.cs:26-53) -> PlaceBlockWithJig (:35, :174-201).
- L = lateral branch, not in the seam: :461-464 -> InsertSelectiveLateralSection (:535-592) -> LateralHeaderDrawService.DrawAndPlace (:588; LateralHeaderDrawService.cs:28-53, 213-271).
The payload is composed in the command layer: WrapSelectivePayload (RackSelectivoCommands.cs:405-417) calls RackEmbedComposer.Compose and RackEmbedStore.Serialize, which are pure Application code. I resolved each delegate and interface target by reading the facades and grepping for implementers. I gave one entry to each distinct mutating API call site. When one API site has several callers, the entry names them all.

contract_required_operations.description: Before any write, verify that database.TransactionManager.TopTransaction is non-null and that its UnmanagedObject equals T_M.UnmanagedObject; refuse otherwise. The insert path has no such check: CreateBlock opens its own transaction (SystemBlockWriter.cs:27). The check exists only in the unreached AUTH-15 RackDefinitionCreator.Precheck (RackDefinitionCreator.cs:151-164).
contract_required_operations.basis: Clause: receive the caller's Database and Transaction; verify the transaction is the live top transaction

contract_required_operations.category: symbol-table addition in the caller's transaction (frontal, one per fondo)
contract_required_operations.description: Create the frontal view definition for EVERY fondo k (0..SelectiveDepthLayout.Count(system)-1), each with its nested ARRAY definitions and pieces (the OP-07..20 primitives), inside T_M with no Commit. Today one fondo is created per command run, chosen by an interactive prompt (RackSelectivoCommands.cs:496-515), in a callee-owned transaction committed at SystemBlockWriter.cs:36.
contract_required_operations.basis: Clause: create the FRONTAL view definition(s) (one per depth/fondo k) in the caller's transaction; NO internal Commit

contract_required_operations.category: symbol-table addition in the caller's transaction (planta)
contract_required_operations.description: Create the planta view definition (OP-07..20 primitives) inside the same T_M as the frontal definitions. Today it is created in a separate command run (view choice RackSelectivoCommands.cs:467-472), in a callee-owned transaction committed at SystemBlockWriter.cs:36.
contract_required_operations.basis: Clause: create the planta view definition in the caller's transaction, entirely inside ONE caller-owned transaction T_M

contract_required_operations.category: Xrecord write of the caller-composed envelope, verbatim, in T_M
contract_required_operations.description: Write the envelope that the orchestrator composed, unchanged, as the RACKCAD_SELECTIVE Xrecord in T_M. It must not be skipped silently. Today the write is skipped when the payload is empty (SystemBlockWriter.cs:31; RackBlockData.cs:22), and the envelope is composed per view and per run by the command layer (RackSelectivoCommands.cs:405-417) rather than by an orchestrator.
contract_required_operations.basis: Clause: the envelope (payload) is composed by the caller and written verbatim

contract_required_operations.category: read-back of the envelope in T_M
contract_required_operations.description: After writing, call RackBlockData.Read(T_M, definitionId) and compare it ordinally with the payload that was written, failing on a mismatch. The insert path performs no read-back. It exists only in the unreached RackDefinitionCreator.Envelope (RackDefinitionCreator.cs:204-211).
contract_required_operations.basis: Clause: the envelope is written verbatim, then read back and compared

contract_required_operations.category: sibling envelopes with the same Id in one T_M
contract_required_operations.description: Write every sibling envelope (frontal k=0..K-1 and planta) in the same T_M with the SAME NewRackId, minted once by the orchestrator. Today the Id is window.RackId from the UI editor identity (RackSelectiveWindow.xaml.cs:191; RackEditorIdentity.cs:18-21). One envelope is written per command run. Siblings are added later through RACKEDITAR Insertar, in separate transactions (RackSelectivoCommands.cs:279).
contract_required_operations.basis: Clause: NewRackId minted once per logical rack by the orchestrator and identical in every sibling envelope

contract_required_operations.category: symbol-table addition under a deterministic effective name
contract_required_operations.description: Create each view BlockTableRecord (and each nested ARRAY definition) under an effective name computed deterministically and reported to the caller. Today UniqueBlockName suffixes _n against the live block table inside the transaction (LateralHeaderDrawer.cs:242, 395-413), so effective names depend on the drawing's prior contents. UNCERTAIN whether the contract accepts a suffix that depends on DB state as deterministic.
contract_required_operations.basis: Clause: effective block names computed deterministically

contract_required_operations.category: entity append of the top-level reference in T_M, without a jig
contract_required_operations.description: Open model space ForWrite through T_M, then call AppendEntity and T_M.AddNewlyCreatedDBObject for the top-level BlockReference, with no jig, no prompt and no internal Commit. Today placement uses editor.Drag inside a callee-owned transaction with its own Commit (BlockPlacement.cs:179-199).
contract_required_operations.basis: Clause: place the block reference in the caller's transaction from a computed transform (no jig, no interaction)

contract_required_operations.category: transform setters on the top-level reference, with a determinant guard
contract_required_operations.description: Set Position, ScaleFactors, Rotation and Normal (or BlockTransform) from the computed transform, after checking that the determinant is strictly positive and that no scale factor is negative. Today only Position is set, through the jig (BlockPlacement.cs:242). The other values remain constructor defaults (BlockPlacement.cs:182), and no determinant or scale check exists on the path.
contract_required_operations.basis: Clause: set position/scale/rotation/normal from the transform (strictly positive determinant, no negative scale)

contract_required_operations.category: entity property setters (layer and properties from the plan)
contract_required_operations.description: Set LayerId or Layer, plus any other planned entity properties, on the top-level reference inside T_M. Today none are set (BlockPlacement.cs:182-196). The reference receives host defaults (UNCERTAIN; see limitations).
contract_required_operations.basis: Clause: set layer and properties from the plan

contract_required_operations.category: dynamic properties on the top-level reference in T_M
contract_required_operations.description: Apply the planned dynamic property values to the top-level reference inside T_M. Today none are applied to it: ApplyDynamicParameters runs only on nested piece references (LateralHeaderDrawer.cs:319, 415-449). The view definition is created as a plain new BlockTableRecord (LateralHeaderDrawer.cs:243) with no dynamic parameters authored by the code, so this step may be a no-op for Selective views (UNCERTAIN).
contract_required_operations.basis: Clause: apply dynamic properties ... INSIDE T_M

contract_required_operations.category: RecordGraphicsModified on the top-level reference in T_M
contract_required_operations.description: Call reference.RecordGraphicsModified(true) on the placed top-level reference inside T_M, with no graphics writes after commit. The insert path never calls it on the top-level reference. It is called only for nested pieces (LateralHeaderDrawer.cs:447) and on the redefine path (LateralHeaderDrawer.cs:167-171, RACKEDITAR only).
contract_required_operations.basis: Clause: RecordGraphicsModified INSIDE T_M, no post-commit graphics writes

contract_required_operations.category: import result (structured; non-mutating output of PREPARE-W)
contract_required_operations.description: Return a structured result: Found/Missing facts per requirement, the imported count, and the failure cause (file missing, unreadable library, clone exception). Today EnsureForPlan returns only an int (BlockLibraryImporter.cs:38), the facts from LibraryBlockAvailabilityFlow are discarded (LibraryBlockRequirements.cs:175-179), the caller ignores the int (SystemBlockWriter.cs:25), a missing file returns 0 (BlockLibraryImporter.cs:88-91), and exceptions are swallowed to 0 (:126-131).
contract_required_operations.basis: Clause: SL-5 PREPARE-W library import with a structured result

contract_required_operations.category: side-database read restricted to an already-opened private copy
contract_required_operations.description: SL-5 should clone only from an already-opened library Database backed by a private copy of the DWG, outside T_M, under the lock, and may use callee transactions. Today the importer opens the shared LibraryPath itself with OpenForReadAndAllShare, into a static cache shared across documents (BlockLibraryDatabaseCache.cs:17-55; BlockLibraryImporter.cs:87-96).
contract_required_operations.basis: Clause: reading ONLY an already-opened library Database of a private copy (outside T_M, under the lock, callee transactions allowed)

contract_required_operations.description: After the writes, verify with reads only: each view definition exists under its expected effective name; its RACKCAD_SELECTIVE Xrecord equals the expected envelope; each definition has exactly one model-space reference with the expected transform, layer and dynamic values. The insert path has no verifier. The only post-insert action is a command-line message (RackSelectivoCommands.cs:471, 522; RackCommandSupport.cs:183-208).
contract_required_operations.basis: Clause: SL-6 read-only verifier and expected-versus-persisted comparator

contract_required_operations.category: failure semantics (no internal transaction control or compensation)
contract_required_operations.description: On failure, return a failure result without calling Commit, Abort or Dispose on T_M, without LockDocument, and without compensating writes; the caller aborts. Today the callees take their own locks (SystemBlockWriter.cs:23; BlockPlacement.cs:135,179) and commit (SystemBlockWriter.cs:36; BlockPlacement.cs:189,198). A cancelled placement is compensated with an erase and purge in new transactions (BlockPlacement.cs:41,123-170). An exception thrown in PlaceAndReport after T_create committed leaves the enveloped definition committed with no cleanup (BlockPlacement.cs:49-52).
contract_required_operations.basis: Clauses: NO internal Commit, Abort, Dispose of caller transaction, LockDocument, OpenCloseTransaction or side-database write; a failed call leaves the caller obliged to abort

transaction_and_lock_sites.detail: ReadDimensionStyleNames, called from E1 (RackSelectivoCommands.cs:32) and E2 (RackMenuCommands.cs:29) before the modal window opens. Read-only.
Read of DimStyleTable and its records (:159-166). Read-only; exceptions swallowed (:171-175).
Taken by the creation callee. It spans the import (OP-01..06) and T_create (:27-38) for both F and P. The seam contract forbids this.
Document-DB read of missing block names, callee-owned, under the lock at SystemBlockWriter.cs:23. No outer transaction.
Read of the library DB's block table (OP-04). WblockCloneObjects (:123) runs after this commit, with no transaction open.
Document-DB availability read after import (LibraryBlockRequirements.cs:178); its facts are discarded by EnsureForPlan.

Callee-owned transaction holding every definition, nested-definition, entity, layer and Xrecord write (OP-07..22) for F and P. It has no Abort. An exception inside it leaves via the using-Dispose without Commit (host rollback), is caught at ViewBlockDraw.cs:53-56, and becomes a Failure result.

Second lock and transaction, opened after T_create committed. editor.Drag(jig) (:184) runs inside them. On cancel the non-resident reference is disposed (:188) and the transaction commits with nothing added (:189). On OK the reference is appended to model space and the transaction commits (:198).
Runs only when the jig is cancelled (PlaceAndReport :37-42). It erases the unreferenced view definition (OP-26).

limitations: This is a static reading of the 3375aadb extract only. Nothing was compiled or executed, and nothing was observed in AutoCAD, so reachability comes from code structure and certainty reflects the data-dependent branches.

Delegates: ViewBlockDraw.DrawAndPlace receives the plan and the block name as Func delegates (ViewBlockDraw.cs:33-34). I resolved them by reading the two facades (SelectiveFrontalDrawService.cs:37-38; SelectivePlantaDrawService.cs:32-33).

Interface dispatch: ILibraryBlockQuery and ILibraryBlockImporter (LibraryBlockRequirements.cs:113-123). The only implementers in src/ are AutoCadLibraryBlockQuery and BlockLibraryImporter.ImportAdapter (grep), both constructed explicitly at BlockLibraryImporter.cs:36-37.

Host-internal effects I cannot enumerate statically:
- WblockCloneObjects may also clone dependent records (layers, linetypes, text and dim styles, nested blocks, regapps, dictionaries); with DuplicateRecordCloning.Ignore the existing records are kept.
- RecomputeDimensionBlock creates or updates an anonymous dimension block.
- How the host persists the per-dimension DIMVAR overrides is not visible.
- Setting Value on a dynamic reference may create anonymous representation blocks.
- AppendEntity may apply database defaults (layer, color, linetype) to unset properties; the code never calls SetDatabaseDefaults.
- Undo recording.
- Disposing an uncommitted Transaction rolls it back. That is host semantics, and on these paths it is the only 'abort'.
Implicit command lock: the commands have no CommandFlags, so they run modal. Any lock the host takes implicitly is not visible in the code.

Data-dependent branches:
- View choice made in the UI (lateral / planta / frontal, RackSelectivoCommands.cs:461-475).
- Fondo prompt when fondoCount > 1 (:496-515).
- ARRAY grouping, which needs at least two identical pieces (HeaderInstanceGrouper.cs:61).
- Annotation toggles and the effective dimension detail.
- Whether a named dim style is present.
- Missing blocks, library file existence and the static cache state.
- User cancel of the jig.
- An empty payload, which silently skips the envelope write.
BlockLibraryDatabaseCache is static state shared across commands and documents (BlockLibraryDatabaseCache.cs:11-15). Whether a given run creates or reads a side DB depends on earlier runs.

The UI and Application layers have no AutoCAD references (csproj files; no 'using Autodesk' outside Plugin), so the WPF windows were not traversed in depth. The builder internals (SelectiveFrontalBuilder, SelectivePlantaBuilder, SelectiveDimensions) were read only as far as needed to establish which HeaderBlockRoles and mirroring can occur.

Reflection: none on these paths, apart from the host registering [CommandMethod] handlers. The Plugin IExtensionApplication.Initialize is empty (PluginInitializer.cs:7-9), and no database or document event handlers or overrules were found in src/RackCad.Plugin (grep).

Scope choices:
- The lateral branch shares the same entry points but is outside the seam (frontal and planta only), so it is listed only as NOT_IN_SEAM call sites (OP-28..31) that reuse the shared primitives.
- RACKEDITAR also reaches DrawSelectiveViewFromAuthored (RackSelectivoCommands.cs:279), but that entry was not assigned and is not enumerated separately.

The contract_required_operations and the SL-role mapping are my classification against the design text. In particular, whether a name suffix that depends on DB state counts as 'deterministic' (CR-07), and whether top-level dynamic properties are a no-op for a plain view definition (CR-11), are UNCERTAIN.
